Units.Name: semantic scan record
Units.Sentence: Records that an agent checked one impacted unit for reader-only couplings, and names the pstack skills a scan may follow.

Units.Name: turn record
Units.Sentence: The Turn written to a change record: state, baseline, seeds, impact, declared IntentDelta, questions, approvals, rejections, scans and end report, with the lookups Approved, Rejected and Waiting.

Units.Name: impact graph
Units.Sentence: Builds the graph a turn follows (intended relations plus live semantic couplings) and computes the impact from the seeds, which the agent may add to but never shrink.

Units.Name: verification evidence
Units.Sentence: Decides whether a verification run lets a turn complete: it must exist, have passed, and have run on the current tree, and a run that edited the tree fails.

Units.Name: grade B findings
Units.Sentence: Finds what the gate cannot read: a consumed contract whose code changed under the same signature, a confirmed coupling whose quoted lines changed, and a direct design unit no one scanned.

Units.Name: end gate
Units.Sentence: Judges the actual topology against the intended one plus this turn's approvals into verdicts, prints each verdict line, folds allowed changes on sync, and contrasts declared with done.

Units.Name: grading and questions
Units.Sentence: Adapts a topology effect to a turn grade (A, B, C), parses and grades a declared change key, and words the human question a grade C item asks.

Units.Name: impact tiers
Units.Sentence: Splits the recorded impact into direct items read closely and far items checked briefly, recomputed from the graph each time.
